complexDefinition.stringValue: To move to or place in a particular position.

definition.stringValue: To place something in a certain location.

text.stringValue: Разместить что-то в определенном месте.
**Put** the coffee on the table.
She carefully **put** the vase on the shelf.
Remember to **put** your dirty clothes in the hamper.

complexDefinition.stringValue: To cause to be in a specified condition.

definition.stringValue: To cause a specific condition or state.

text.stringValue: Вызывать определенное состояние или условие.
**Put** your mind at rest; I'll handle the situation.
The exciting news **put** her in a great mood.
The heavy workload **put** him under a lot of stress.

complexDefinition.stringValue: To force (someone) to undergo something.

definition.stringValue: To force someone to experience something.

text.stringValue: Заставить кого-то испытать что-то.
**Put** him through a rigorous training program.
She was **put** through unnecessary stress at work.
Their argument **put** me in an awkward position.

complexDefinition.stringValue: To set before the mind for consideration.

definition.stringValue: To suggest for consideration.

text.stringValue: Предложить для рассмотрения.
**Put** this plan on the table for our discussion tomorrow.
I **put** forward the idea of remote working to the team.
You could **put** your questions directly to the lecture later.

complexDefinition.stringValue: To express in words.

definition.stringValue: To express something using words.

text.stringValue: Выразить что-то с помощью слов.
**Put** it simply, he's not interested.

complexDefinition.stringValue: To devote (time, effort, or energy) to a particular purpose.

definition.stringValue: To use time or effort for a particular goal.

text.stringValue: Использовать время или усилия для достижения определенной цели.
**Put** your energy into studying for your finals.

He **put** a lot of time into perfecting his craft.

complexDefinition.stringValue: To apply (one's mind) to a subject or task.

text.stringValue: Сосредоточить умственные усилия на задаче.
**Put** your concentration on this math problem.
I **put** all my focus into studying for the exam.

complexDefinition.stringValue: To frame or formulate in a particular way.

**Put** it nicely, she's not good at her job.

complexDefinition.stringValue: To attribute; ascribe.

definition.stringValue: To attribute or ascribe something.

text.stringValue: Приписывать или относить что-то к чему-то.
**Put** the success down to hard work and determination.

complexDefinition.stringValue: To submit for consideration, judgment, or use.
